charrestore.npc.deflect: I am waiting for someone. Move along, traveler.
charrestore.npc.lost_parcel: I seem to have lost the parcel I was carrying. Speak with the authorities.
charrestore.npc.confirmed: Good. I knew it was you. Let me tell you how I came to have your things.
charrestore.npc.wrong_person: My apologies for the confusion. I will keep looking.
charrestore.npc.farewell: Safe harbors to you. Learn these waters before you venture out again.
charrestore.npc.bag_denied_open: This parcel is not yours to open.
charrestore.dialog.body.greeting: Hold there, traveler. Are you the one who was stranded by the sea's whim? I have been carrying something that belongs to you — or so I have been told. It would help me to know I have found the right person before I hand it over.
charrestore.dialog.body.story:
I thought as much. The sea gives and the sea takes — but sometimes a keen eye and quick hands can recover what the tides would claim. I pulled what I could from the wreckage before the current swept it away. Not every soul would bother, but I have seen too many good people lose everything to the waters. It is not right.

I have it all bundled here. Ready to receive it?
charrestore.dialog.body.handoff:
Here you are — your salvaged belongings. Take it all. It belongs to you, and the sea owes you at least this much.

A piece of advice from an old salvager: learn the coastlines before you sail them. The sea does not forgive twice.
charrestore.dialog.btn.not_me: No, you have the wrong person.
charrestore.dialog.btn.accept: Yes, please. I am ready to receive my belongings.
charrestore.dialog.btn.thanks: Thank you, salvager. I will remember this.
